description: The line plot illustrates the validation performance, measured in Bits Per Character (BPC), of two models—XMoE and SimSMoE—over the course of training, with the x-axis representing training steps scaled by 10³ (ranging from 0 to 50,000 steps) and the y-axis showing BPC values from approximately 1.1 to 2.25. The XMoE model (yellow line with triangle markers) begins at roughly 2.2 BPC, drops sharply in the first 10,000 steps to around 1.3 BPC, then gradually declines to approximately 1.2 BPC by 50,000 steps. The SimSMoE model (magenta line with circle markers) starts slightly lower at about 2.15 BPC, follows a similar steep initial decline to ~1.3 BPC by 10,000 steps, and then stabilizes near 1.2 BPC, remaining consistently below XMoE for most of the training duration. Both lines exhibit a rapid initial improvement followed by a plateau, with SimSMoE consistently achieving a slightly better (lower) BPC than XMoE after ~5,000 steps, suggesting improved validation performance under the SimSMoE routing policy.
